title: Account Management
description: The organization manages system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, disabling, and removing accounts in accordance with organizational procedures.
llm_specific_guidance: Applies to LLM agent service accounts, API consumer accounts, and database connector credentials. Requires programmatic provisioning, immediate revocation on breach, and automated session timeouts.

title: Access Enforcement
description: The system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.
llm_specific_guidance: Enforces Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) over LLM tool-calling capabilities. An LLM agent must never execute administrative or destructive system commands without explicit role elevation and policy authorization.

title: Least Privilege
description: The organization employs the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (and processes acting on behalf of users) which are necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.
llm_specific_guidance: Restricts autonomous LLM agents to read-only database connections where feasible, sandboxes bash/python code execution, and scopes third-party API tokens to the bare minimum permission set required.

title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
description: The system uniquely identifies and authenticates organizational users (or processes acting on behalf of organizational users).
llm_specific_guidance: Requires Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for administrative access to LLM prompt pipelines, fine-tuning infrastructure, model weights, and enterprise vector databases.

title: Authenticator Management
description: The organization manages system authenticators, including tokens, certificates, and passwords, ensuring secure generation, distribution, and rotation.
llm_specific_guidance: Enforces secure cryptographic storage for API keys (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic), automatic secret rotation, and strict prevention of hardcoded keys in prompts or repositories.

title: Information Input Validation
description: The system checks the validity of information inputs to verify correctness, syntax, and conformance with expected formats.
llm_specific_guidance: Primary defense against Prompt Injection and Jailbreaks. Requires strict input sanitization, structural delimiter enforcement, character limit boundaries, and adversarial heuristic scanning prior to LLM processing.

title: Error Handling
description: The system generates error messages that provide necessary information for authorized personnel while withholding information that could be exploited by adversaries.
llm_specific_guidance: Mitigates System Prompt and Architecture Leakage. Prevents LLMs from regurgitating internal system instructions, vector embeddings, backend server paths, or raw stack traces when an error occurs.

title: Boundary Protection
description: The system monitors and controls communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.
llm_specific_guidance: Deploys LLM Guardrails, Prompt Firewalls (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), and egress filtering to inspect outgoing model completions for unauthorized data exfiltration.

title: Protection of Information at Rest
description: The system protects the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest using cryptographic mechanisms.
llm_specific_guidance: Enforces AES-256 encryption across vector databases (ChromaDB, FAISS), training corpus storage, fine-tuned weights, and cached prompt/completion repositories.

title: Event Logging
description: The organization identifies the types of events that the system must log to support auditing and investigation.
llm_specific_guidance: Logs all incoming prompt timestamps, user IDs, raw prompts (with PII token masking), LLM completions, token consumption metrics, and tool invocation parameters for forensic review.

title: Non-repudiation
description: The system provides non-repudiation services to protect against an individual falsely denying that a particular action took place.
llm_specific_guidance: Cryptographically signs AI audit logs, agent debate transcripts, and compliance reports with SHA-256 hashes to guarantee provenance and audit evidentiary integrity.

title: Incident Handling
description: The organization implements an incident handling capability for security incidents that includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
llm_specific_guidance: Defines explicit incident response playbooks for AI security failures: immediate automated LLM circuit-breaker tripping, session termination upon jailbreak detection, and fallback to deterministic safe responses.

title: Incident Monitoring
description: The organization tracks and documents system security incidents.
llm_specific_guidance: Integrates real-time anomaly detection for sudden spikes in adversarial prompt patterns, token-exhaustion denial of service attempts, and unauthorized data leakage vectors into the SOC dashboard.

title: Incident Reporting
description: The organization reports security incident information to designated authorities and organizational leadership.
llm_specific_guidance: Automates incident notification workflows compliant with statutory requirements: CERT-In 6-hour cybersecurity reporting and GDPR/DPDP Act 2023 72-hour customer breach notification guidelines.
